title: INV-CSG-17 Consignment Stock Entry
summary: Ledgerline screen for recording incoming supplier consignment deliveries and settling consumed consignment stock.
body:
Screen INV-CSG-17 (Consignment Stock Entry) records incoming supplier consignment deliveries and tracks their consumption in Ledgerline [^r1][^r18]. It allows Northbridge Cycles to increment on-hand physical inventory without booking an unvouched liability or affecting owned stock valuation until parts are consumed [^r19][^r20]. When parts are issued to assembly lines or dispatched, settlement transfers ownership and posts accounting entries [^r4][^r5][^r20].

## Fields

| Field label | Field name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| SUP CD | `sup_cd` | Vendor code; mandatory field under menu Inventory > Consignment stock [^r1][^r12][^r15]. |
| ITEM CD | `itm_cd` | Component or part item code; mandatory [^r1][^r2][^r15]. |
| QTY | `qty` | Counted consignment quantity; mandatory [^r1][^r2][^r15]. |
| CSG NO | `csg_no` | Serial consignment reference number generated by the system; left empty during new receipt creation [^r1][^r2][^r3][^r11]. |
| STATUS | `status` | Record status indicator, assigned as active/open upon initial save; left empty during new receipt creation [^r1][^r2][^r3][^r11]. |

To record new incoming consignment stock, users enter `sup_cd`, `itm_cd`, and `qty`, leaving `csg_no` and `status` empty, and trigger `csg_save` [^r2]. Ledgerline generates the next serial consignment number in `csg_no`, sets `status` to active, and warehouse staff must note the generated `csg_no` on the physical vendor delivery note [^r3][^r11].

Consignment parts provide an explicit ownership indicator alongside location entries on stock maintenance and warehouse enquiry displays [^r18]. Ownership transfer and supplier self-billing accrual or invoice match entries trigger only upon consumption transfer onto active assembly lines [^r20].

## Keys and services

INV-CSG-17 connects to the [[services-inv-csg|INV consignment services]] introduced in Ledgerline 7.1 [^r1][^r13]:

* `csg_save`: Commits consignment stock receipts requiring supplier code, item code, and quantity, assigning the next serial `csg_no` and setting `status` to active [^r1][^r3][^r15].
* `csg_get`: Read service (POST `/ll72/svc/csg_get`) using input field `csg_no` to retrieve parcels and verify `status` prior to settlement [^r1][^r4][^r14].
* `csg_search`: Read service used to search records; querying by `sup_cd` alone returns all open consignments for that vendor [^r1][^r10][^r16].
* `csg_settle`: Internal settlement service executed when parts are consumed for assembly or bicycle shop dispatch, adjusting stock balances, setting consignment status, and writing ledger entries [^r1][^r4][^r5][^r17].

## Messages

* [[err-csg-0001]]: Displayed when executing `csg_save` or `csg_settle` without completing mandatory entries (`sup_cd`, `itm_cd`, `qty`) or upon a loss of connection [^r6].
* [[err-csg-0201]]: Displayed when `csg_settle` is selected against a parcel that is already fully settled, cancelled, or frozen by central finance, or when attempting to overwrite an archived record via `csg_save` [^r7].
* [[err-itm-0011]]: Displayed when the entered `itm_cd` does not exist, is inactive, discontinued, or not authorised for consignment handling [^r8].
* [[err-sup-0030]]: Displayed when the entered `sup_cd` is unrecognised, inactive, or lacks an active consignment contract setup in accounts [^r9].

## Versions and conflicts

* **New delivery entry and initial status**: In current documentation (v7.2.3), `csg_no` and `status` are left empty on delivery creation, and `csg_save` generates `csg_no` and sets `status` to active [^r2][^r3][^r11]. Superseded manual MAN-INV-72 v7.2.2 (2024-06-10) marked `csg_no` as a mandatory input field and indicated that `csg_save` marked `status` as "held on site" (`superseded`) [^r21][^r22].
* **Error message triggers**: In current documentation (v7.2.3), ERR-CSG-0001 indicates missing mandatory fields or connection drops, and ERR-CSG-0201 indicates settlement of an already settled, cancelled, or frozen record or overwriting an archive [^r6][^r7]. Superseded manual MAN-INV-72 v7.2.2 defined ERR-CSG-0001 as consignment number not found and ERR-CSG-0201 as settlement quantity exceeding balance (`superseded`) [^r23].

* [[err-csg-0201|ERR-CSG-0201 QTY MUST BE > 0 / Invalid Consignment Status]]
* [[err-itm-0011|ERR-ITM-0011 ITEM NOT FOUND OR INACTIVE]]
* [[err-sup-0030|ERR-SUP-0030]]
* [[services-inv-csg|INV csg services]]
* [[screen-inv-itm-01|INV-ITM-01 Item Master Entry]]

r1.quote: Screen INV-CSG-17, menu Inventory > Consignment stock. Services: csg_save, csg_get, csg_search, csg_settle.

r2.section: To record newly delivered consignment stock:
r2.loc_text: p. 65, To record newly delivered consignment stock:
r2.quote: Leave the CSG NO field empty. Ledgerline will automatically assign the sequential reference upon completion.

r3.section: To record newly delivered consignment stock:
r3.loc_text: p. 65, To record newly delivered consignment stock:
r3.quote: Note the system-generated CSG NO on the physical vendor delivery note and store the paper document in the site goods inwards file.

r4.loc_text: p. 65, To settle consumed consignment stock:
r4.quote: Retrieve the appropriate consignment lot using the CSG NO field and the csg_get (CONSIGNMENT STOCK GET) button.

r5.quote: Ledgerline triggers the internal settlement service, adjusting the balance of stock, setting the record to its settled or partially settled condition

r6.quote: It occurs when a user attempts to execute csg_save or csg_settle without completing all mandatory entries, or when the system detects inconsistent record parameters.

r7.quote: It appears when pressing csg_settle against a record that is already marked fully settled, cancelled, or frozen by central finance.

r8.quote: It occurs when the value entered in the ITEM CD field does not exist within the Ledgerline inventory master records

r9.quote: It appears when the value entered into the SUP CD field is unrecognised, refers to an inactive account, or belongs to a vendor lacking a valid consignment contract setup

r10.quote: Searching by SUP CD alone will return all open consignments for that vendor, helping to prevent the accidental creation of duplicate parcel entries.

r11.quote: the system generates the reference in the CSG NO field and assigns an open state in the STATUS field.

r12.quote: INV-CSG-17 CONSIGNMENT STOCK ENTRY Menu: Inventory > Consignment stock. Roles: [STORES, STORES-MGR, PUR-EXEC, SYS-ADMIN]. Label Field Type Mandatory F2 lookup SUP CD sup_cd

r13.quote: csg_save CONSIGNMENT STOCK SAVE Kind: write. Screen: INV-CSG-17. Since: 7.1. Procedures: sp_csg_save.

r14.quote:
service: csg_get
title: CONSIGNMENT STOCK GET
module: INV
kind: read
screen: INV-CSG-17

r15.quote: service: csg_save title: CONSIGNMENT STOCK SAVE module: INV kind: write screen: INV-CSG-17

r16.quote: service: csg_search title: CONSIGNMENT STOCK LIST module: INV kind: read screen: INV-CSG-17

r17.quote: service: csg_settle title: CONSIGNMENT STOCK SETTLE module: INV kind: write screen: INV-CSG-17

r18.quote: The release introduces consignment stock handling under reference INV-CSG-17, altering how goods held on behalf of third parties or stored at partner locations are tracked within Ledgerline ERP. On screen, the stock maintenance and warehouse enquiry displays now provide an explicit ownership indicator alongside standard location entries.

r19.quote: Users recording receipts can allocate incoming parts directly to a consignment category, preventing these items from being absorbed into general company valuation while keeping them visible for production scheduling.

r20.quote: Testing must also cover the transfer of these parts to assembly lines, ensuring that an ownership transfer entry is triggered only at the point of consumption, thereby generating the appropriate supplier self-billing accrual or invoice match entry.

r21.quote: sup_cd SUP CD Yes itm_cd ITEM CD Yes qty QTY Yes csg_no CSG NO Yes status STATUS No

r22.quote: Ledgerline calls service CONSIGNMENT STOCK SETTLE to transfer ownership to Northbridge Cycles and update STATUS.

r23.quote: ERR-CSG-0001: The system cannot find the consignment record matching the entered CSG NO. • ERR-CSG-0201: The requested settlement quantity exceeds the available consignment balance.

conflicts.today: CSG NO and STATUS are left empty when recording new deliveries, and csg_save sets STATUS to active and generates the serial consignment number
conflicts.other: In v7.2.2, CSG NO was listed as mandatory and csg_save marked STATUS as held on site

conflicts.today: ERR-CSG-0001 indicates missing mandatory fields (SUP CD, ITEM CD, QTY) on save/settle or connection loss, and ERR-CSG-0201 indicates settling an already settled, cancelled, or frozen record or overwriting an archived record
conflicts.other: In v7.2.2, ERR-CSG-0001 indicated CSG NO not found, and ERR-CSG-0201 indicated settlement quantity exceeded balance
